RIKU_SP.title: SP (Situation Points)
RIKU_SP.description:
Current: [gold]%SP%[/gold] / %MAXSP% SP.

Gain [gold]1 SP[/gold] at the start of each turn. Attacks grant [gold]2 SP[/gold]. Dark Sleights grant [gold]3 SP[/gold].

At [gold]30 SP[/gold], gain [purple]Dark Mastery[/purple] for 4 turns, and add a [gold]Situation Command[/gold] into your Hand.
RIKU_DARKNESS.title: Darkness
RIKU_DARKNESS.description:
Charge [purple]Darkness[/purple] by playing [gold]3 Attacks[/gold].

When you have [purple]Darkness[/purple], your next Attack or Skill gains [gold]+2 Damage[/gold] and [green]+2 Block[/green], and Dark Sleights gain additional effects.
RIKU_DARK_MASTERY.title: Dark Mastery
RIKU_DARK_MASTERY.description:
Riku has fully controlled the power of darkness.

Gain the benefits of Darkness automatically.

Accumulate [gold]30 SP[/gold] to gain stronger Situation Commands.
RIKU_SITUATION_COMMAND.title: Situation Command
RIKU_SITUATION_COMMAND.description:
Special Commands that become available at key moments during combat.

Reach [gold]30 SP[/gold] to gain a Situation Command.

While in [purple]Dark Mastery[/purple], accumulating another [gold]30 SP[/gold] grants access to stronger Situation Commands.

Using a Situation Command consumes it and resets your SP.
RIKU_DARK_SLEIGHT.title: Dark Sleight
RIKU_DARK_SLEIGHT.description:
Dark Sleights grant [gold]3 SP[/gold] when played.

While you have [purple]Darkness[/purple] or [gold]Dark Mastery[/gold], Dark Sleights gain additional effects.
